description: A FastAPI application demonstrating background task handling with dependency injection for query parameters. Defines an endpoint to send notifications and logs messages asynchronously.

methods.name: write_log(message: str)
methods.description: Writes a message to the log file asynchronously.

methods.name: get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Union[str, None] = None)
methods.description: Dependency that retrieves the query parameter and schedules log writing as a background task.

methods.name: send_notification( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Annotated[str, Depends(get_query)] )
methods.description: Endpoint that sends notification by scheduling a log write as a background task with the provided email and query.

ctags.name: get_query
ctags.pattern: /^def get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Union[str, None] = None):$/

ctags.name: send_notification
ctags.signature: ( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Annotated[str, Depends(get_query)] )
